summary: In this excerpt from Book 1 (part 170), the narrator Marcus and his companion Masha swap their appearance and flee San Francisco after a mob incident, climbing uphill through the Tenderloin toward a rendezvous. Their escape is cut off in Sabin Place by Charles, a former schoolmate in a half-hearted VampMob costume, who has recorded Marcus leading the mob on his phone and threatens to call the police. The passage is a tense chase-and-confrontation scene with the story's Xnet, VampMob and surveillance themes in the background.
one_line: Marcus and Masha flee San Francisco's Tenderloin after a mob incident, only to be cornered in Sabin Place by Charles, who recorded Marcus leading the mob.
key_facts: Masha tells Marcus that after the mob footage is analyzed, every face in it will go into a database, and that they are both wanted criminals now.
Masha says, "You've got two choices now. Me, or jail."
Marcus says he sprained his foot and that "No gait recognition program will spot me now."
The total time for the changeover of their appearance was less than a minute.
Masha leads Marcus off Market Street into the Tenderloin, a neighborhood where they had hunted for an open WiFi access-point on the day of Harajuku Fun Madness.
The route climbs uphill toward the zone where the Tenderloin gives way to the Nob Hill real-estate district.
The pair moves through narrow alleys and uses big streets only to reach the next alley.
They are stopped in Sabin Place when a person says, "Freeze right there."
Charles stands at the mouth of the alley wearing a halfhearted VampMob outfit of black t-shirt, jeans and white face-paint.
Charles says he has been on the Xnet since he saw Marcus giving out DVDs at school.
Charles says he recorded Marcus leading the VampMob and intends to call the cops and wait for them.
Charles threatens that Marcus will go to "pound-you-in-the-ass prison, for a long, long" term.
Masha had gone still as a board beside Marcus during the confrontation.
